definition: Intel's Deep Learning Boost (DL Boost) is a marketing name for instruction set architecture (ISA) features on the x86-64 designed to improve performance on deep learning tasks such as training and inference..
details: Intel's Deep Learning Boost (DL Boost) is a marketing name for instruction set architecture (ISA) features on the x86-64 designed to improve performance on deep learning tasks such as training and inference.

explainer.lead: Intel DL Boost is a name for features added to the x86-64 instruction set to improve deep learning performance. It targets both training models and running them for inference, using processor capabilities rather than a separate model or software library.

tiers.eli5: Think of a processor as a kitchen and deep learning as a recipe that requires lots of repeated chopping. DL Boost is like adding kitchen tools made for that chopping, so the work can be done more efficiently. It helps computers both learn from examples and use what they learned to answer new questions.
tiers.practitioner: Treat DL Boost as processor instruction-set support, not as a framework or neural network design. On compatible Intel x86-64 systems, deep learning software can use its features for training and inference. Any performance benefit depends on the software and workload actually using those features; the name alone does not specify a speedup.
tiers.paperLevel: DL Boost is Intel's marketing designation for x86-64 instruction set architecture features designed to improve performance on deep learning training and inference. It is an ISA-level label, not a neural-network architecture, learning algorithm, or benchmark. The label by itself does not define individual instructions, numerical formats, processor generations, or quantitative performance gains.

flow: A deep learning training or inference task runs on a compatible Intel x86-64 processor.
The software uses the instruction-set features identified as DL Boost.
Those features are designed to improve the workload's performance.
explainer.origin: Intel created the DL Boost name for deep-learning-oriented instruction set features on x86-64.
explainer.whyItMatters: DL Boost connects deep learning performance to capabilities in the processor itself. It is relevant to both sides of a model's life cycle: learning from data and producing predictions afterward.

diagram.caption: DL Boost sits at the instruction-set level, supporting deep learning training and inference workloads.
